lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold the note against it. The handwriting doesn't change. Neither does that.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold the old photo next to it. Happier times for the photo. Same times for this.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold the other half up to the light. Still ..14. The light doesn't fill in the rest.
lines.tts: I hold the other half up to the light. Still ..14. The light doesn't fill in the rest.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I hold the receipt up to the webcam. '1 BTC @ $3.50.' PZ-BOT: 'HISTORICAL DATA. NOT ALPHA.' It needs words. Bad ones.

lines.text: I hold the sign-in sheet to the camera. The scanner beeps no. Visitors sign in. Patients get in.
lines.tts: I hold the sign-in sheet to the camera. The scanner beeps no. Visitors sign in. Patients get in.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold the sign-in sheet up to it. Nobody on the list matches. Not even it.
lines.tts: I hold the sign-in sheet up to it. Nobody on the list matches. Not even it.

lines.text: I hold the slice up to it. A drop of grease falls. Nothing else happens. Nothing ever does.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold the token up to the sign. They're hiring builders, not investors. Huh.

lines.text: I hold the vet bill up to the keypad. DOORIS doesn't read. DOORIS listens. I should talk to it.
lines.tts: I hold the vet bill up to the keypad. DOORIS doesn't read. DOORIS listens. I should talk to it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up 7314. No keypad here. Numbers are useless without buttons.
lines.tts: I hold up 7314. No keypad here. Numbers are useless without buttons.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up his own crumpled note. He looks away. 'Some days I believe in the tech. Some days the tech doesn't believe in me.'
lines.tts: I hold up his own crumpled note. He looks away. 'Some days I believe in the tech. Some days the tech doesn't believe in me.'

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up my wrist. Nobody checks bracelets but Nurse Gwei.
lines.tts: I hold up my wrist. Nobody checks bracelets but Nurse Gwei.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up Pepe. Pepe holds up his tiny 3D glasses. Nothing happens. Classic Pepe.
lines.tts: I hold up Pepe. Pepe holds up his tiny 3D glasses. Nothing happens. Classic Pepe.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the 73. Nothing happens. Half a clue does half of nothing.
lines.tts: I hold up the 73. Nothing happens. Half a clue does half of nothing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the ape costume. 'Fur is worn, old chap. Not brandished.'
lines.tts: I hold up the ape costume. 'Fur is worn, old chap. Not brandished.'

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the bill. 'Diagnosis: perfect.' That's Gerald's. This isn't.
lines.tts: I hold up the bill. 'Diagnosis: perfect.' That's Gerald's. This isn't.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the blank paper. It says nothing. It agrees with everything.
lines.tts: I hold up the blank paper. It says nothing. It agrees with everything.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the box of floppies. It rattles. Nothing loads. Still beautiful.
lines.tts: I hold up the box of floppies. It rattles. Nothing loads. Still beautiful.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the burned chip. Smells like ambition. Does nothing.
lines.tts: I hold up the burned chip. Smells like ambition. Does nothing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the floppy. 'DO NOT LOSE.' Handing it over counts as losing. I keep it.
lines.tts: I hold up the floppy. 'DO NOT LOSE.' Handing it over counts as losing. I keep it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the Ledger. The screen says nothing. It came out from under a doormat. It's seen worse.
lines.tts: I hold up the Ledger. The screen says nothing. It came out from under a doormat. It's seen worse.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the map. The path matches. I don't need to wave it at the path, though. I can just walk.
lines.tts: I hold up the map. The path matches. I don't need to wave it at the path, though. I can just walk.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up the rare Pepe to B.O.T.
lines.tts: I hold up the rare Pepe to B.O.T.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hold up two fingers and pinch the cabin. Got it. ...I don't have it.
lines.tts: I hold up two fingers and pinch the cabin. Got it. ...I don't have it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I hum on the path. The echo hums back, slightly off-key. Probably me.
lines.tts: I hum on the path. The echo hums back, slightly off-key. Probably me.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I insert a floppy from the box into the trading desk's reader. The three monitors sync instantly.
lines.tts: I insert a floppy from the box into the trading desk's reader. The three monitors sync instantly.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I insert the floppy disk... *KRRRTTT*... The drive spins up. Data flooding the screen.
lines.tts: I insert the floppy disk... ... The drive spins up. Data flooding the screen.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I insert the Golden ZERO Token into a slot on the mining rig. The screens flash: 'GOLDEN KEY ACCEPTED — FOUNDER MODE UNLOCKED.'
lines.tts: I insert the Golden ZERO Token into a slot on the mining rig. The screens flash: 'GOLDEN KEY ACCEPTED — FOUNDER MODE UNLOCKED.'

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I insert the trading terminal key into the keyhole. It fits. The mechanisms align — authorization and physical key together.
lines.tts: I insert the trading terminal key into the keyhole. It fits. The mechanisms align — authorization and physical key together.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I jiggle the mouse. The screen shows a patient management system. All fields say 'ENCRYPTED'. Even their software has trust issues.
lines.tts: I jiggle the mouse. The screen shows a patient management system. All fields say 'ENCRYPTED'. Even their software has trust issues.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I jump and grab the chain. The lamp swings. Penny sighs the sigh of a pending form.
lines.tts: I jump and grab the chain. The lamp swings. Penny sighs the sigh of a pending form.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I jump for the drainpipe. I miss by a lot. The magpies watch. I'd need something long.
lines.tts: I jump for the drainpipe. I miss by a lot. The magpies watch. I'd need something long.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I jump for the fixture. I miss by a mile. I land loudly. Nobody comes. Typical.
lines.tts: I jump for the fixture. I miss by a mile. I land loudly. Nobody comes. Typical.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I kneel and touch the floor. Cold. Clean. Mopped recently. Someone was expecting company.
lines.tts: I kneel and touch the floor. Cold. Clean. Mopped recently. Someone was expecting company.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I kneel and whisper to the floor. 'Any secret basements down there?' The tiles remain tight-lipped.
lines.tts: I kneel and whisper to the floor. 'Any secret basements down there?' The tiles remain tight-lipped.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I knock on the hatch. The echo takes a long time to come back. A very long time.
lines.tts: I knock on the hatch. The echo takes a long time to come back. A very long time.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I knock. Something knocks back. Three times. Like a three-factor door. I back away slowly.
lines.tts: I knock. Something knocks back. Three times. Like a three-factor door. I back away slowly.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean against a boulder. It's warm from the sunset. Best chair on the mountain.
lines.tts: I lean against a boulder. It's warm from the sunset. Best chair on the mountain.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean against a pine. The bark is rough. I get sap on my coat. Adrian's coat. Sorry, Adrian.
lines.tts: I lean against a pine. The bark is rough. I get sap on my coat. Adrian's coat. Sorry, Adrian.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean against a tree. The tree has more patience than me. Everyone does, apparently.
lines.tts: I lean against a tree. The tree has more patience than me. Everyone does, apparently.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean it against the fence. The fence doesn't need help. It needs a plank back.
lines.tts: I lean it against the fence. The fence doesn't need help. It needs a plank back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean on it with my full weight. My full weight is not enough.
lines.tts: I lean on it with my full weight. My full weight is not enough.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean on the fence. It creaks. One plank creaks louder. It wants out.
lines.tts: I lean on the fence. It creaks. One plank creaks louder. It wants out.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean on the railing and survey the city. Wind in my hair. I'd look great on a book cover.
lines.tts: I lean on the railing and survey the city. Wind in my hair. I'd look great on a book cover.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean on the railing. It creaks. I stop leaning on the railing.
lines.tts: I lean on the railing. It creaks. I stop leaning on the railing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean over the desk: 'Hello?' The echo answers. It also has no appointment.
lines.tts: I lean over the desk: 'Hello?' The echo answers. It also has no appointment.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lean over the edge. My knees vote no. Unanimously.
lines.tts: I lean over the edge. My knees vote no. Unanimously.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I leave behind what I've already used up. Lighter pockets. Same heavy bags.
lines.tts: I leave behind what I've already used up. Lighter pockets. Same heavy bags.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I leave the keycard on her desk. Penny stares at it like it bit someone. I take it back before she logs it.
lines.tts: I leave the keycard on her desk. Penny stares at it like it bit someone. I take it back before she logs it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I leave the vet bill on the desk. Penny reads it in one second. 'A duck. Not confidential. Just sad.' She slides it back.
lines.tts: I leave the vet bill on the desk. Penny reads it in one second. 'A duck. Not confidential. Just sad.' She slides it back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I let the sunrise wash over me. No screen, no candles. Just light. It doesn't want anything from me.
lines.tts: I let the sunrise wash over me. No screen, no candles. Just light. It doesn't want anything from me.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lift a corner. Behind it, an older poster: 'HANG IN THERE.' A kitten. Also hanging in there.
lines.tts: I lift a corner. Behind it, an older poster: 'HANG IN THERE.' A kitten. Also hanging in there.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lift a corner. Underneath, an older poster: 'YOU'VE GOT THIS.' Somebody didn't.
lines.tts: I lift a corner. Underneath, an older poster: 'YOU'VE GOT THIS.' Somebody didn't.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lift a tile. Cables, a lost USB stick and half a sandwich with seniority.
lines.tts: I lift a tile. Cables, a lost USB stick and half a sandwich with seniority.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lift the hatch and climb down the ladder into the lobby.
lines.tts: I lift the hatch and climb down the ladder into the lobby.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lift the lid. Empty cans. A banana peel. Somebody's resolve.
lines.tts: I lift the lid. Empty cans. A banana peel. Somebody's resolve.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I lift the lid. The smell hits first. Then I spot something crumpled at the bottom...
lines.tts: I lift the lid. The smell hits first. Then I spot something crumpled at the bottom...

lines.tts: I line up the torn edges. 73... 14. It reads: '7314. If you found both halves, you're patient enough. — A.'

lines.text: I look at it. It looks back. Neither of us learns anything.
lines.tts: I look at it. It looks back. Neither of us learns anything.

lines.text: I look at it through the spare 3D glasses. It's still there. Now in red and cyan.
lines.tts: I look at it through the spare 3D glasses. It's still there. Now in red and cyan.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I look at the CRT through the 3D glasses. It's still dark. In two colours.
lines.tts: I look at the CRT through the 3D glasses. It's still dark. In two colours.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I look at the monitor through the spare 3D glasses. Double the glasses, half the picture.
lines.tts: I look at the monitor through the spare 3D glasses. Double the glasses, half the picture.

lines.text: I look at the red poster through the 3D glasses. One eye sees it. The other sees nothing. My brain files a complaint.
lines.tts: I look at the red poster through the 3D glasses. One eye sees it. The other sees nothing. My brain files a complaint.

lines.text: I look at the sunrise through the 3D glasses. Red and cyan. ...I take them off. It's just a sunrise.
lines.tts: I look at the sunrise through the 3D glasses. Red and cyan. ...I take them off. It's just a sunrise.

lines.text: I look behind a poster. Just wall. And a moth. Of course there's a moth.
lines.tts: I look behind a poster. Just wall. And a moth. Of course there's a moth.

lines.text: I look closer. One section is labeled 'PHASE 2: PATIENT ZERO.' It's circled three times. Whatever that phase is, it mattered.
lines.tts: I look closer. One section is labeled 'PHASE 2: PATIENT ZERO.' It's circled three times. Whatever that phase is, it mattered.

lines.text: I look for a card reader on the front door. There isn't one. Adrian's front door is old-fashioned. Rude.
lines.tts: I look for a card reader on the front door. There isn't one. Adrian's front door is old-fashioned. Rude.

lines.tts: I look for a coin slot in the front door. Nope. Shame. I'd pay to get in.

lines.text: I look for a drive. No drive. VIP access denied by furniture.
lines.tts: I look for a drive. No drive. VIP access denied by furniture.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I look for a floppy slot. There isn't one. It's not 1997 in here.
lines.tts: I look for a floppy slot. There isn't one. It's not 1997 in here.

lines.text: I look for a keyhole. No keyhole. The fob blinks green anyway. Very supportive.
lines.tts: I look for a keyhole. No keyhole. The fob blinks green anyway. Very supportive.

lines.text: I look for a USB port. No port. The Ledger stays unplugged and smug.
lines.tts: I look for a USB port. No port. The Ledger stays unplugged and smug.

lines.text: I look for a way in. There isn't one. Story of this whole house.
lines.tts: I look for a way in. There isn't one. Story of this whole house.

lines.text: I look for a way to open it. It's a very private object. Penny would approve.
lines.tts: I look for a way to open it. It's a very private object. Penny would approve.

lines.text: I look for somewhere to drop the token. There isn't. The shiny thing stays.
lines.tts: I look for somewhere to drop the token. There isn't. The shiny thing stays.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I look for somewhere to put it on the CRT. The CRT has no idea what that is.
lines.tts: I look for somewhere to put it on the CRT. The CRT has no idea what that is.

lines.text: I look for the off switch. There isn't one. This screen was built not to let me leave.

lines.text: I look through the window with the spare 3D glasses. Somebody watched from in there. In red and cyan, probably.
lines.tts: I look through the window with the spare 3D glasses. Somebody watched from in there. In red and cyan, probably.

lines.text: I mash Enter. The screen fills with errors. I feel like a real professional.
lines.tts: I mash Enter. The screen fills with errors. I feel like a real professional.

lines.text: I mash it against the keypad. It doesn't even beep. That's how bad an idea it was.
lines.tts: I mash it against the keypad. It doesn't even beep. That's how bad an idea it was.

lines.text: I mash keys I can barely see. The screen responds with garbled colors. Useless without clear vision.
lines.tts: I mash keys I can barely see. The screen responds with garbled colors. Useless without clear vision.

lines.text: I mash them together. My pockets disapprove. Loudly.
lines.tts: I mash them together. My pockets disapprove. Loudly.

lines.tts: I nail the half note to the plank. Now it's a tiny protest sign. 'GIVE ME THE OTHER HALF.' I take it back off.

lines.text: I nearly hand over the patient file. Doctor-patient confidentiality. I'm neither, but still.
lines.tts: I nearly hand over the patient file. Doctor-patient confidentiality. I'm neither, but still.

lines.text: I need to get up there first. The path is the only way.
lines.tts: I need to get up there first. The path is the only way.

lines.text: I nudge Chad's ring. He drifts two metres and acts like he meant it. He's good at that.
lines.tts: I nudge Chad's ring. He drifts two metres and acts like he meant it. He's good at that.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I nudge it. Still in my pocket. Nobody's taking it. Not on my watch.
lines.tts: I nudge it. Still in my pocket. Nobody's taking it. Not on my watch.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I nudge the camera up. Now it films the sky. I nudge it back. I'm not a vandal. Yet.
lines.tts: I nudge the camera up. Now it films the sky. I nudge it back. I'm not a vandal. Yet.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I nudge the coat. It swings back. Starched. It could stand up on its own.
lines.tts: I nudge the coat. It swings back. Starched. It could stand up on its own.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I nudge the dish. A speaker crackles, then reads out block numbers. From orbit. Adrian gets his news from space.
lines.tts: I nudge the dish. A speaker crackles, then reads out block numbers. From orbit. Adrian gets his news from space.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I nudge the lamp. It swings. Three moths file a complaint.
lines.tts: I nudge the lamp. It swings. Three moths file a complaint.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I nudge the monitor. The green line wobbles. Stays up. I'm not looking at it. I'm not.
lines.tts: I nudge the monitor. The green line wobbles. Stays up. I'm not looking at it. I'm not.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I nudge the pack with my foot. Something rattles. Something always rattles.
lines.tts: I nudge the pack with my foot. Something rattles. Something always rattles.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer Gerald the golden token. Gerald doesn't do money. Gerald has a vet bill and no regrets.
lines.tts: I offer Gerald the golden token. Gerald doesn't do money. Gerald has a vet bill and no regrets.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer it to the empty air. The air politely declines.
lines.tts: I offer it to the empty air. The air politely declines.

lines.tts: I offer one a towel. 'Dry? In this economy?' He sinks a little lower.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer the 3D glasses. They're prescription. I take them back.
lines.tts: I offer the 3D glasses. They're prescription. I take them back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer the ape costume. They'd never fit in the Pool. I keep it.
lines.tts: I offer the ape costume. They'd never fit in the Pool. I keep it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer the bartender my energy drink. 'I do not drink. I am the drinks.'
lines.tts: I offer the bartender my energy drink. 'I do not drink. I am the drinks.'

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer the broken mouse by its tail. That's not a gift. That's a threat.
lines.tts: I offer the broken mouse by its tail. That's not a gift. That's a threat.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer the chip. Worth nothing. It agrees.
lines.tts: I offer the chip. Worth nothing. It agrees.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I offer the cord around. Nothing to plug in. Neither do I, emotionally.
lines.tts: I offer the cord around. Nothing to plug in. Neither do I, emotionally.

lines.tts: I offer the desk a pen. It leaks a blue map of Japan on Penny's blotter. She hands it back with tongs.

lines.tts: I offer the monkey sticker. All three heads look hurt. I put it back.

lines.tts: I offer the sun a nod. It gives back warmth, light and a slight squint. Fair trade.

lines.text: I offer the terminal key. Then I picture explaining that to Adrian. I keep it.

lines.text: I offer up the energy drink. No takers. Five hundred milligrams of caffeine, unloved.

lines.tts: I open a bottle. Fizz. 'That is the house IPA,' the robot says. 'It tastes different every time. That is a defect.'

lines.speaker: player

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the sign. It wobbles, then holds. Better posture than me.

lines.text: I push the tagged wall. The paint doesn't smudge. Good paint. Bad decisions.

lines.tts: I push the trash back into a pile. An ape nods. 'Tidy, old chap.' He throws a peel on it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the tray aside. Papers slide everywhere. I tidy them up. Penny would want that. I fear Penny.
lines.tts: I push the tray aside. Papers slide everywhere. I tidy them up. Penny would want that. I fear Penny.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the trunk. It's been standing longer than me. It's better at it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the tube. The goo sloshes and glares at me. Goo can glare. I've learned that today.
lines.tts: I push the tube. The goo sloshes and glares at me. Goo can glare. I've learned that today.

lines.text: I push the unit. More water leaks. I stop pushing. Detective work is mostly knowing when to stop.

lines.text: I push the vane. The vane pushes back. Rust wins.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the wall. Solid under the rot. Good bones, bad skin. Like me, the doctor would say.
lines.tts: I push the wall. Solid under the rot. Good bones, bad skin. Like me, the doctor would say.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the wall. The house stays. Good house.
lines.tts: I push the wall. The house stays. Good house.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the wall. The wall wins. Walls always win.
lines.tts: I push the wall. The wall wins. Walls always win.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push the wall. The wall stays. Walls are good at that.

lines.tts: I push the weather vane. It creaks and swings back east. The cable to the hatch stays slack — still unlatched.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I push the weather vane. It creaks and swings west. Bearish sentiment. The cable to the hatch stays slack — still unlatched.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push through the door and head back down.
lines.tts: I push through the door and head back down.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push through the flowers. They spring right back up. No hard feelings.
lines.tts: I push through the flowers. They spring right back up. No hard feelings.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push toward the mountains. They stay exactly that far away. Mountains are like that.
lines.tts: I push toward the mountains. They stay exactly that far away. Mountains are like that.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I push toward the window. The bushes push back. Harder.
lines.tts: I push toward the window. The bushes push back. Harder.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put it away. When the time comes, this file will reveal everything.
lines.tts: I put it away. When the time comes, this file will reveal everything.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put it back in my pocket. Card stored securely. Unlike most private keys.
lines.tts: I put it back in my pocket. Card stored securely. Unlike most private keys.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put it back. It never left.
lines.tts: I put it back. It never left.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put it on the desk. Penny moves it off the desk. Silently. Terrifyingly.
lines.tts: I put it on the desk. Penny moves it off the desk. Silently. Terrifyingly.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put my ear to the cables. A gentle buzz. Like a fridge that's thinking about something.
lines.tts: I put my ear to the cables. A gentle buzz. Like a fridge that's thinking about something.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put my thumb over it. The water goes round my thumb. Water always wins.
lines.tts: I put my thumb over it. The water goes round my thumb. Water always wins.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put on the ape costume. The fur is warm. The mask smells like diamond hands and bad decisions. I look ridiculous. I look perfect.
lines.tts: I put on the ape costume. The fur is warm. The mask smells like diamond hands and bad decisions. I look ridiculous. I look perfect.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put Pepe next to where Pepe was. Now there's a Pepe and the memory of a Pepe.
lines.tts: I put Pepe next to where Pepe was. Now there's a Pepe and the memory of a Pepe.

lines.text: I put the 3D glasses on the duck. He looks like an influencer. I take them back before he gets a following.
lines.tts: I put the 3D glasses on the duck. He looks like an influencer. I take them back before he gets a following.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the cap back on. 'Thank you,' says the robot. 'Nobody here closes anything.'
lines.tts: I put the cap back on. 'Thank you,' says the robot. 'Nobody here closes anything.'

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the chair upright. It swivels back to the monitor by itself. Clingy.
lines.tts: I put the chair upright. It swivels back to the monitor by itself. Clingy.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the cushion back. Nobody will ever know I was here.
lines.tts: I put the cushion back. Nobody will ever know I was here.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the duck in the water bottle. It floats! ...I don't know what I expected. This is neither useful nor a bathtub.
lines.tts: I put the duck in the water bottle. It floats! ...I don't know what I expected. This is neither useful nor a bathtub.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the glasses back under the floor. No. Whoever hid them wanted them found. By me, apparently.
lines.tts: I put the glasses back under the floor. No. Whoever hid them wanted them found. By me, apparently.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the key back on the desk. The desk doesn't want it back. Nobody wants anything back.
lines.tts: I put the key back on the desk. The desk doesn't want it back. Nobody wants anything back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the keycard back in the coat. Then take it out again. I'm here to be paid, not to be honest.
lines.tts: I put the keycard back in the coat. Then take it out again. I'm here to be paid, not to be honest.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the Ledger back under the mat. Then I take it out again. Nobody needs to know.
lines.tts: I put the Ledger back under the mat. Then I take it out again. Nobody needs to know.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the pen back in the pocket. The pocket starts turning blue. I take the pen back. The pocket stays blue.
lines.tts: I put the pen back in the pocket. The pocket starts turning blue. I take the pen back. The pocket stays blue.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the photo away. History captured in a single frame.
lines.tts: I put the photo away. History captured in a single frame.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the photo face-down. Now nobody's watching. Including the one with no face.
lines.tts: I put the photo face-down. Now nobody's watching. Including the one with no face.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I put the PIN on Penny's desk. She covers her eyes. 'I didn't see a number. HR doesn't do numbers.' I take it back.

lines.text: I put the sheet back in the drop box. Then take it out again. Evidence first, manners later.
lines.tts: I put the sheet back in the drop box. Then take it out again. Evidence first, manners later.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I put the tile back. It clicks into place. The most satisfying thing that's happened all week.
lines.tts: I put the tile back. It clicks into place. The most satisfying thing that's happened all week.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach behind the bracket. Still warm, not lethal. A torn scrap of paper.
lines.tts: I reach behind the bracket. Still warm, not lethal. A torn scrap of paper.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for a bottle. The robot takes it back before my hand arrives. Faster than me. Faster than anyone.
lines.tts: I reach for a bottle. The robot takes it back before my hand arrives. Faster than me. Faster than anyone.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for a cloud. I'm short by about two kilometres.
lines.tts: I reach for a cloud. I'm short by about two kilometres.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for a dangling cable. Then I remember I like my eyebrows. I leave it dangling.
lines.tts: I reach for a dangling cable. Then I remember I like my eyebrows. I leave it dangling.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for a star. I get a handful of cold air and a moth. The moths followed me up here.
lines.tts: I reach for a star. I get a handful of cold air and a moth. The moths followed me up here.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for it. A thorn reaches for me. The thorn's faster.
lines.tts: I reach for it. A thorn reaches for me. The thorn's faster.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for its control panel. 'Buy me a drink first,' it says. I can't. It's the one with the drinks.
lines.tts: I reach for its control panel. 'Buy me a drink first,' it says. I can't. It's the one with the drinks.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for the camera. The LED panics. I think I just triggered an alert. Smooth.
lines.tts: I reach for the camera. The LED panics. I think I just triggered an alert. Smooth.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach for the handle. A cold draft pushes back. The air smells like... memes? Digital decay? Something glows faintly behind the door.
lines.tts: I reach for the handle. A cold draft pushes back. The air smells like... memes? Digital decay? Something glows faintly behind the door.

lines.text: I reach for the lights. My hands wave in the air like I just don't care. I do care. I'm short.
lines.tts: I reach for the lights. My hands wave in the air like I just don't care. I do care. I'm short.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I reach for the off button. 'NO!' scream all the apes at once. I step back slowly.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I reach for the sunset. My arm isn't long enough. Nobody's is.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I reach toward the blurry shape. If only I could see clearly through this optical nightmare...
lines.tts: I reach toward the blurry shape. If only I could see clearly through this optical nightmare...

lines.tts: I read aloud: 'Patient Zero was never who you thought.' Chills. Literal chills.

lines.tts: I read aloud: 'Step 1: admit you are powerless over leverage.' Step 2 just says 'See Step 1.'

lines.tts: I read it aloud: 'Gwei.' The intercom crackles, offended. I didn't write it, Nurse.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I read out the code. 'Seven. Three. One. Four.' Nobody here is a door.
lines.tts: I read out the code. 'Seven. Three. One. Four.' Nobody here is a door.

lines.tts: I read the fine print aloud: 'Side effects of bright ideas may include seed phrase generation, whitepaper writing, and spontaneous DAO formation.'

lines.tts: I rub it on the doormat. Cleaner now. Still mine. Still not useful here.

lines.tts: I rub the slice on it. Now it's greasy and still useless. Grease isn't magic. Mostly.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I rub them together. No sparks. No magic. Just a faint smell of pizza.

lines.tts: I rummage. The thorns rummage back. Nobody finds anything.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I rummage through the junk. My hand comes out sticky and wiser.

lines.tts: I run a finger over my engraved address. Warm brass. Patient Zero, founder. Somebody polishes this weekly.

lines.tts: I run the orange cord from the socket to the CRT. Exactly a metre. Last mile solved.

lines.text: I say a few words. The rack says none. Fitting, for a funeral.
lines.tts: I say a few words. The rack says none. Fitting, for a funeral.

lines.text: I say hello. It says nothing. Honestly, a better listener than Penny.
lines.tts: I say hello. It says nothing. Honestly, a better listener than Penny.

lines.text: I say hello. The concrete eats it. Lovely acoustics, for screaming.
lines.tts: I say hello. The concrete eats it. Lovely acoustics, for screaming.

lines.tts: I scan the log entries. Timestamps, error codes, and someone's desperate 3 AM debugging session.

lines.tts: I scrape the paint. A dozen layers, each a slightly different white. Somebody had a lot of meetings about this.

lines.tts: I scratch at the graffiti. Under 'Gwei' someone wrote 'was here' in pencil. Under THAT: 'we are all here.'

lines.tts: I scratch at the grout between tiles. Nothing gives. Whoever laid these tiles was not messing around.

lines.tts: I set the duck down, then take him back. He didn't like it there.

lines.tts: I set the Ledger by her keyboard. Penny puts on gloves to hand it back. She keeps gloves for this.

lines.speaker: player

lines.text: I should check the monitor first.
lines.tts: I should check the monitor first.

lines.text: I shouldn't mess with the doctor's coat while he's wearing it.
lines.tts: I shouldn't mess with the doctor's coat while he's wearing it.

lines.tts: I shout a question at the sky. The sky shrugs a cloud at me.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I shout toward the light. The blinking pauses. Then carries on. I've been ignored by a bulb.

lines.tts: I shout toward where the light was. Darkness doesn't shout back. Good manners, at least.

lines.tts: I sit. The chair squeaks a complaint. I flip a magazine. Every headline aged like milk.

lines.text: I slide it towards the monitor. The monitor doesn't care. Penny does.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I snap the shell back together. Rest in pixels, little mouse.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I snap the shell back. It won't click shut. A mouse that can't click. Poor thing.
lines.tts: I snap the shell back. It won't click shut. A mouse that can't click. Poor thing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I sniff the coat. Antiseptic and regret. The official clinic perfume.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I speak into it like a microphone. *feedback screech* Nope.

lines.text: I speak into the bottle. My voice echoes. 'HODL... hodl... hodl...'
lines.tts: I speak into the bottle. My voice echoes. 'HODL... hodl... hodl...'

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I speak into the dish. My voice goes up to orbit. A satellite leaves me on read.

lines.tts: I splash Gerald. The apes gasp. He lives in a pool. He's fine. Everyone calm down.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I splash my face. Cold! Very cold. I'm awake. I'm extremely awake.
lines.tts: I splash my face. Cold! Very cold. I'm awake. I'm extremely awake.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I squeak the duck at it. It doesn't squeak back. No sense of humour.

lines.tts: I squeeze the ape head. The foam compresses with a wheeze. It sounds like a leveraged position being liquidated.

lines.text: I squeeze the duck at the doctor. 'Interesting. And how does that make you FEEL?' He's turned the session on me.
lines.tts: I squeeze the duck at the doctor. 'Interesting. And how does that make you FEEL?' He's turned the session on me.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I squint at it. My 3D glasses add nothing. They never do.
lines.tts: I squint at it. My 3D glasses add nothing. They never do.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I squint at the clouds. That one's a duck. That one's... also a duck. Gerald, is that you?
lines.tts: I squint at the clouds. That one's a duck. That one's... also a duck. Gerald, is that you?

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I squint through the red-blue haze. Numbers flicker on a screen... 99%... something. Can't read the rest.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stand where a car should be. I don't go anywhere.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stare at it for a while. Patience, they said. Still nothing.

lines.tts: I step back. From here it looks like a spider's tax return.

lines.speaker: player

lines.tts: I step on a peel on purpose. Classic. The apes score it: '7, mate. Weak landing.'

lines.text: I step on the cables. They don't even notice. Built to outlast the patients. Rude, but accurate.
lines.tts: I step on the cables. They don't even notice. Built to outlast the patients. Rude, but accurate.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stomp on a loose tile. It wobbles. No secret. Just bad grouting.
lines.tts: I stomp on a loose tile. It wobbles. No secret. Just bad grouting.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stomp on a tile. It shifts. Cold air shoots up my trouser leg. Uninvited.
lines.tts: I stomp on a tile. It shifts. Cold air shoots up my trouser leg. Uninvited.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stomp on the floor. Solid. No hollow sound. No secret passage. Just a sore heel.
lines.tts: I stomp on the floor. Solid. No hollow sound. No secret passage. Just a sore heel.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I straighten a poster. Behind it, scratched in the wall: 'Day 3. Still here.' Dark. Ish.
lines.tts: I straighten a poster. Behind it, scratched in the wall: 'Day 3. Still here.' Dark. Ish.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I straighten the frame. It tilts back. It's not ready to be straight with me.
lines.tts: I straighten the frame. It tilts back. It's not ready to be straight with me.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stretch it out. The thermal ink is fading. Like the memory of cheap Bitcoin.
lines.tts: I stretch it out. The thermal ink is fading. Like the memory of cheap Bitcoin.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stretch it out. The ink is already fading. Like most altcoin roadmaps.
lines.tts: I stretch it out. The ink is already fading. Like most altcoin roadmaps.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stretch the arms apart. They spring back. These glasses have been through some things.
lines.tts: I stretch the arms apart. They spring back. These glasses have been through some things.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stretch the costume arms. The fur is surprisingly elastic. Designed for aggressive hand gestures, no doubt.
lines.tts: I stretch the costume arms. The fur is surprisingly elastic. Designed for aggressive hand gestures, no doubt.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I stretch the duck. It bounces back. Resilient. Unlike my portfolio.
lines.tts: I stretch the duck. It bounces back. Resilient. Unlike my portfolio.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I study the faces. Hopeful smiles. They really believed they could cure crypto addiction.
lines.tts: I study the faces. Hopeful smiles. They really believed they could cure crypto addiction.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I swing the loose antenna at the glass panel like a baseball bat.
lines.tts: I swing the loose antenna at the glass panel like a baseball bat.

lines.tts: I swipe Adrian's keycard over the screen. It reads me instead. Awkward for both of us.

lines.text: I swipe Adrian's keycard. The reader thinks about it. Red.

lines.text: I swipe the card across the keypad. It's a keypad. It has no idea what a card is.

lines.text: I swipe the keycard on the terminal. No reader. Server rooms trust nobody. Smart.

lines.text: I swipe the keycard over it. No reader. Just me, swiping air like an idiot.
lines.tts: I swipe the keycard over it. No reader. Just me, swiping air like an idiot.

lines.text: I take a paper cup. Then I put it back. They're counting.

lines.tts: I take off the ape costume and stuff it back in my pocket. How does it even fit in there? Best not to question adventure game logic.

lines.tts: I talk to the monitor. It displays: 'VOICE RECOGNIZED. WELCOME BACK.' Back? I've never been here. ...have I?

lines.tts: I tap a pipe. It clangs all through the house. Somewhere upstairs, a moth panics.

lines.tts: I tap the card on it. Adrian's photo stares back, disappointed.

lines.tts: I tap the poster. The red glow is just the lighting. I'm still a little scared of it.

lines.tts: I tear open the seal... Inside: a single sheet with coordinates and a cryptic note: 'Find Patient Zero before they find you.'

lines.tts: I touch the glass. The goo swirls faster. A readout: 'VIRALITY: CRITICAL'. I take my hand back. Slowly.

lines.tts: I trace the timeline with a finger. It starts with 'FIRST MINT!' and a smiley. It ends with 'Again.'

lines.text: I try combining them. They refuse to be a team. Like DOORIS and everyone.

lines.tts: I try the door. It resists, then yields with a metallic shriek. Red and cyan light pours through the crack.

lines.tts: I try to back up the Ledger onto the floppy. One point four four megabytes. My trust issues alone are bigger.

lines.tts: I try to bribe the wall. Incorruptible. Also a wall.
